n940b7907b16.s: After the bifurcation of Andhra Pradesh, royalties from onshore oil and gas accrue to:
o: The State where the resource is produced
The State with the longer coastline
Both successor States in equal shares
n940b7907b16.x: Onshore oil and gas royalties go to the producing State; gas allocation itself follows Government of India policy.

n22b579e98bf.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the division of Central Generating Station (CGS) power after bifurcation?
o: Andhra Pradesh received only about 46% of CGS power
Andhra Pradesh had about 58% of the population
CGS power was divided in the population ratio
CGS power was divided on the basis of the last five years' consumption
n22b579e98bf.x: CGS power was split by the last five years' consumption, not by population, which is why AP got about 46% despite having about 58% of the population.

n5b6af99e174.s: Under the Forest Rights Act, 2006, the Gram Sabha recommends diversion of forest land for:
n5b6af99e174.x: Under FRA the Gram Sabha clears diversion of forest land for public utilities, not for commercial mining.

n1ea4b2ee49f.s: Regarding the 2014 ad hoc sharing of KWDT-I's 811 TMC of Krishna water, which pair is correctly matched?
n1ea4b2ee49f.x: AP got 512 TMC and Telangana 299 TMC, about 66:34; the 58:42 population ratio was not used for Krishna water.

n1c868b2aa92.s: How many Nagar Vans were sanctioned to Andhra Pradesh under the Central Nagar Van Yojana?
n1c868b2aa92.x: The Central Nagar Van Yojana sanctioned 61 Nagar Vans; 37 is the count of city forests under the State's Nagaravanam programme.

n3ac4424878d.s:
Consider the following statements about the central share of Centrally Sponsored Scheme costs:
1. Under Special Category Status, the Centre bears 90 percent of the costs.
2. Under the ordinary arrangement, the Centre bears 60 percent of the costs.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
n3ac4424878d.x: Both are true: Special Category Status gives a 90 percent central share, while 60 percent is the ordinary arrangement.

ne6fde043f80.s:
Consider the following statements about events after the bifurcation of Andhra Pradesh:
1. The 14th Finance Commission award came before the enactment of the AP Reorganisation Act.
2. The 14th Finance Commission raised States' share of the divisible pool from 32% to 42%.
3. The TDP left the NDA over the Special Category Status row in 2018.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
ne6fde043f80.x: APRA was enacted in 2014 and the 14th FC award (raising devolution to 42%) applied from 2015, so statement 1 is wrong; the TDP left the NDA in 2018.

n610856d327b.s:
Consider the following statements about the Krishna and Godavari River Management Boards:
1. They are autonomous bodies under the administrative control of the Centre.
2. Each Board has a full-time Member Secretary and one central expert.
3. Each Board has three members from each State.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
n610856d327b.x: Under Sections 85(3) and 85(4) the Boards are autonomous bodies under Central control, with a Central Chairperson, two members per State, a central expert and a full-time Member Secretary; so statement 3 is wrong.

n068b5b26e50.s: Regarding the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014, which pair is correctly matched?
o: Section 85(2) – Headquarters of both Boards in Telangana
Section 84(1) – Apex Council constituted by the Centre from the appointed day
Section 89 – Polavaram declared a national project
Section 91 – Jurisdiction of the Boards over notified projects
n068b5b26e50.x: Section 84(1) provides for constitution of the Apex Council by the Centre from the appointed day; KRMB HQ is in AP (85(2)), Polavaram is under Sec. 90 and jurisdiction under Sec. 87.

n3cf766f6eb0.s: Which of the following is a function of the Apex Council under Section 84(3) of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014?
o: Allocating or redetermining the shares of the States in river waters
Guarding the reservoirs through the CISF
Notifying the projects under the jurisdiction of the Boards
Supervising the Krishna and Godavari River Management Boards
n3cf766f6eb0.x: The Apex Council supervises the Boards, approves new projects, settles disputes by negotiation and refers disputes to a tribunal; allocating shares is not its function.

new.s: Tummalapalle in YSR Kadapa district is known for deposits of:
new.x: Tummalapalle has uranium; barytes is at Mangampet, also in YSR Kadapa.

new.s: In Andhra Pradesh, bauxite deposits occur mainly at:
new.x: Bauxite is found at Araku, Chintapalli and Paderu; the coast has beach-sand minerals.

new.s: After bifurcation, the left-bank power stations at Srisailam and Nagarjuna Sagar went to:
new.x: The left bank went to Telangana and the right bank to Andhra Pradesh.

new.s: The equity of the Singareni Collieries Company Limited (SCCL) is held as:
new.x: SCCL is 51% Telangana and 49% Government of India, as coal went mainly to Telangana.

new.s: The area of residual Andhra Pradesh rose from 1,60,205 to 1,62,970 sq km due to the addition of:
new.x: Seven Khammam mandals were added to AP, raising its area to 1,62,970 sq km.

new.s: The population ratio between Andhra Pradesh and Telangana adopted under the AP Reorganisation Act is:
new.x: The APRA ratio is 58.32 : 41.68; 66 : 34 is the ad hoc Krishna water split.

new.s: Which is the most advanced of Andhra Pradesh's four greenfield ports?
new.x: Ramayapatnam is the most advanced of the four greenfield ports; Visakhapatnam is the only major port.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh contributes about what share of India's fish production?
new.x: AP gives about 29% of India's fish; 75% is its share of cultured-shrimp exports.

new.s: The only major port of Andhra Pradesh is:
new.x: AP has one major port, Visakhapatnam; Krishnapatnam is the busiest non-major port.

new.s: The Polavaram Project is planned to divert how much water to the Krishna basin?
new.x: Polavaram is planned to transfer 80 TMC to the Krishna basin.

new.s: The planned irrigation potential of the Polavaram Project is:
new.x: Polavaram is planned to irrigate 7.20 lakh acres, besides 960 MW of power.

new.s: Residual Andhra Pradesh holds the deltas of which rivers?
new.x: The Godavari, Krishna and Penna deltas lie in residual AP.

new.s: Among the old districts of Andhra Pradesh, which had the largest forest area?
new.x: YSR Kadapa had the largest forest area; Visakhapatnam had the most cover and Krishna the least.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about forests in the old districts of Andhra Pradesh?
o: Visakhapatnam had the most forest cover
YSR Kadapa had the largest forest area
Krishna had the largest forest area
Krishna had the least forest cover
new.x: Krishna had the least forest cover; the largest forest area was in YSR Kadapa.

new.s: The biennial India State of Forest Report (ISFR) is published by:
new.x: ISFR is a biennial report of the Forest Survey of India (FSI), Dehradun.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's protected-area network consists of:
o: 13 National Parks, 3 Wildlife Sanctuaries, 1 Tiger Reserve
3 National Parks, 13 Wildlife Sanctuaries, 2 Tiger Reserves
1 National Park, 13 Wildlife Sanctuaries, 3 Tiger Reserves
3 National Parks, 13 Wildlife Sanctuaries, 1 Tiger Reserve
new.x: AP has 3 National Parks, 13 Wildlife Sanctuaries and 1 Tiger Reserve.

new.s: Coringa in Andhra Pradesh is an example of which forest type?
new.x: Coringa is a mangrove forest at the Godavari mouth.

new.s: Moist deciduous forests in Andhra Pradesh are found mainly in:
new.x: Moist deciduous forests are in the north-coastal hills; Kadapa-Kurnool has dry deciduous and interior Rayalaseema thorn-scrub.

new.s: What is the IUCN status of Red Sanders (2021)?
new.x: Red Sanders was listed as Endangered by the IUCN in 2021.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Red Sanders:
1. It is endemic to the southern Eastern Ghats.
2. It is listed in Appendix I of CITES.
3. Its ranges include Seshachalam and Nallamala.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Red Sanders is endemic to the southern Eastern Ghats and grows in Seshachalam and Nallamala; it is in CITES Appendix II, not I.

new.s: The Girijan Cooperative Corporation (GCC) of Andhra Pradesh has its headquarters at:
new.x: GCC is headquartered at Visakhapatnam; it buys minor forest produce and runs MSP for MFP.

new.s: Trade in beedi leaf was nationalised in Andhra Pradesh in:
new.x: Beedi leaf was nationalised in 1971 under the AP MFP (Regulation of Trade) Act; 1956 and 1970 relate to GCC.

new.s: Which body procures minor forest produce in Andhra Pradesh and runs MSP for MFP?
new.x: The Girijan Cooperative Corporation buys MFP and runs MSP for MFP.

new.s: Joint Forest Management through Vana Samrakshana Samithis began in Andhra Pradesh in:
new.x: JFM via Vana Samrakshana Samithis began in 1992; Community Forest Management followed in 2002.

new.s: As of 31 August 2026, how many individual Forest Rights Act titles had been given in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: AP had 2,27,300 individual titles against 2,90,874 claims.

new.s: Under the Andhra Pradesh Forest Act, 1967, the power to reserve a forest is given by Section:
new.x: Section 3 gives the power to reserve; Section 4 is the preliminary notice and Section 15 the final notification.

new.s: Regarding the Andhra Pradesh Forest Act, 1967, which pair is correctly matched?
o: Section 4 – Protected forest ceases to be protected
new.x: Section 15 is the final notification; Section 3 is the power to reserve and Section 28 lets a protected forest cease to be protected.

new.s: The Green India Mission, launched in 2011, is part of:
o: The National Action Plan on Climate Change
new.x: The Green India Mission (2011) is a mission under the NAPCC, aiming at 5 mha new plus 5 mha quality improvement.

new.s: The revenue deficit grant to Andhra Pradesh for 2014-15 amounted to:
new.x: The RD grant for 2014-15 was ₹3,979 crore; ₹4,118 crore was the Union Finance Ministry's gap estimate.

new.s: The 2014-15 revenue deficit grant of ₹3,979 crore was released in instalments up to:
new.x: The grant was released in instalments up to 2016-17.

new.s: Revenue deficit grants given to Andhra Pradesh by the 14th Finance Commission for 2015-20 were:
new.x: The 14th FC gave RD grants of ₹22,113 crore for 2015-20.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Finance Commissions and Andhra Pradesh?
o: The 14th FC raised devolution from 32% to 42%
The 14th FC was the first to end revenue deficit grants for all States
The 14th FC ended the general/special category distinction
The 16th FC raised AP's divisible-pool share to 4.22%
new.x: It was the 16th FC that ended RD grants for all States; the 14th FC gave AP ₹22,113 crore in RD grants.

new.s: The division between Andhra Pradesh and Telangana after bifurcation followed the population ratio of:
new.x: The division followed the population ratio 58.32 : 41.68 (AP : Telangana).

new.s: Genome Valley, lost to Andhra Pradesh with Hyderabad, is a cluster of which industry?
new.x: Genome Valley is a pharma cluster; HITEC City and the Financial District were the IT/ITeS hubs.

new.s: The Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act received presidential assent on:
new.x: Assent came on 1 March 2014; 2 June 2014 was the appointed day.

new.s: Backward-area packages for Andhra Pradesh are provided under which section of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014?
new.x: Section 46 covers backward-area packages; Section 94(1) tax holidays and Section 94(3) ₹2,500 crore for capital buildings.

new.s: Special Category Status was promised to Andhra Pradesh on the floor of the Rajya Sabha in 2014 for:
new.x: SCS for 5 years was promised in the Rajya Sabha in 2014.

new.s: The Centre refused Special Category Status to Andhra Pradesh citing which Finance Commission, which ended the general/special category distinction?
new.x: The 14th FC ended the general/special category distinction and raised devolution from 32% to 42%.

new.s: The actual revenue deficit of Andhra Pradesh in 2022-23 was:
new.x: The actual 2022-23 RD was ₹43,487 crore (3.3% of GSDP) against a projection of about ₹17,000 crore.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Andhra Pradesh's fiscal indicators for 2024-25:
1. Accounts at a Glance put the revenue deficit at 3.75% of GSDP.
2. The Finance Accounts put the revenue deficit at 3.79% of GSDP.
3. The FRBM revenue-deficit target was 4% of GSDP.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Accounts at a Glance gives 3.75% and the Finance Accounts 3.79%; the FRBM RD target was 2.70%, while 4% is the fiscal-deficit ceiling.

new.s: Guarantees given by the Andhra Pradesh government in 2023-24 were about:
new.x: Guarantees in 2023-24 were ₹1,54,797 crore, about 11% of GSDP.

new.s: Market loans make up about what share of Andhra Pradesh's debt?
new.x: Market loans are about 75% of AP's debt; 35.15% is the debt-GSDP ratio.

new.s: In the 2024-25 Revised Estimates, against revenue spending of ₹2,24,343 crore, Andhra Pradesh's capital outlay was only:
new.x: Capital outlay was only ₹24,072 crore against revenue spending of ₹2,24,343 crore.

new.s: Which is the largest component of Andhra Pradesh's own tax revenue (2025-26 BE)?
new.x: State GST is the largest, about 37% of own tax revenue in 2025-26 BE.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's own tax revenue in 2023-24 (actuals) was:
new.x: Own tax revenue was ₹85,922 crore (6% of GSDP) in 2023-24, rising to ₹1,09,007 crore in 2025-26 BE.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Andhra Pradesh's own tax heads in 2023-24 (actuals)?
o: State GST was the largest head
Stamps and registration yielded more than State excise
Sales tax / VAT yielded more than State excise
Taxes on vehicles yielded less than stamps and registration
new.x: Stamps and registration gave ₹9,542 crore, less than State excise (₹15,998 crore).

new.s: Andhra Pradesh attributes its fiscal stress to a shrinking revenue base, interest, welfare spending and:
o: The loss of a capital city
new.x: AP blames a shrinking revenue base, interest, welfare and the loss of a capital city.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh joined the UDAY scheme on 24 June 2016 as the:
new.x: AP signed UDAY on 24 June 2016 as the 13th State; it was the 2nd State in DoE power reforms.

new.s: Under UDAY, the Andhra Pradesh government took over DISCOM debt of about:
new.x: The State took over about ₹11,000 crore of DISCOM debt under UDAY.

new.s: In August 2022, the Union Power Ministry ordered Telangana to pay APGENCO power dues of about:
new.x: Under Sec. 92 of APRA the Ministry ordered Telangana to pay about ₹6,756 crore to APGENCO.

new.s: The 2022 Union order on Telangana's power dues to APGENCO was quashed in October 2023 by:
new.x: The Telangana High Court quashed the order in October 2023.

new.s: Which Article of the Constitution lets Parliament make law for adjudicating inter-State river water disputes?
new.x: Article 262 is the constitutional base; the ISRWD Act, 1956 was enacted under it.

new.s: Which section of the Inter-State River Water Disputes Act, 1956 bars the Supreme Court and other courts from disputes referable to a tribunal?
new.x: Section 11 is the court bar; Section 5(1) was used in October 2023 for KWDT-II's new terms.

new.s: In the Cauvery case (1991), the Supreme Court held that the court bar does not cover its appeal jurisdiction under:
new.x: The Supreme Court held that the bar does not cover its appeal jurisdiction under Article 136.

new.s: The 2014 ad hoc sharing ratio of Krishna water between Andhra Pradesh and Telangana is:
new.x: The ad hoc split is AP 512 TMC : Telangana 299 TMC = 66 : 34; the 58:42 population ratio was not used.

new.s: What is Andhra Pradesh's stand on Krishna water sharing?
o: Redo allocations among four States with Telangana as a separate party
Divide water in the population ratio 58 : 42
Make the ad hoc 66 : 34 split permanent without a tribunal
new.x: AP wants Telangana added as a separate party and allocations redone among four States; 50:50 is Telangana's demand.

new.s: Section 89 of the AP Reorganisation Act extended the term of KWDT to frame:
o: An automatic division of undivided AP's share
An operational protocol for releases in deficit flows
new.x: Sec. 89 extended KWDT for project-wise allocation and an operational protocol for releases in deficit flows.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about KWDT-II:
1. Section 89 of APRA automatically divided undivided AP's share between AP and Telangana.
2. In October 2023, KWDT-II was given terms to divide AP's share between AP and Telangana.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Section 89 did not divide the share automatically; the October 2023 terms under Sec. 5(1) of the ISRWD Act asked KWDT-II to do so.

new.s: KWDT-II shared surplus flows calculated at what dependability?
new.x: KWDT-II used 65%-dependable flows; KWDT-I used 75% dependability.

new.s: KWDT-I gave its award in 1973; its final award came in:
new.x: KWDT-I's final award came in 1976; 1980 is GWDT and 2010/2013 are KWDT-II.

new.s: Under Section 91(2) of APRA, the Tungabhadra Board regulates:
o: Pothireddypadu Head Regulator and Rayalaseema Lift
High Level Canal, Low Level Canal and Rajolibanda Diversion Scheme
new.x: Sec. 91(2) covers the High Level Canal, Low Level Canal and Rajolibanda Diversion Scheme.

new.s: Which section of APRA, 2014 makes AP and Telangana replace undivided AP on the Tungabhadra Board?
new.x: Section 91(1) puts AP and Telangana in place of undivided AP on the Board.

new.s: In the Supreme Court's 2018 Cauvery verdict, Karnataka's share was fixed at:
new.x: Karnataka got 284.75 TMC; Tamil Nadu 404.25, Kerala 30 and Puducherry 7.

new.s: Palamuru-Rangareddy is a project of which State on which river?
new.x: Palamuru-Rangareddy is Telangana's project on the Krishna; Kaleshwaram is on the Godavari.

new.s: The Jal Shakti committee on the Polavaram-Nallamala Sagar Link, which first met on 30 January 2026, is headed by:
new.x: The committee is under the Central Water Commission Chairman.

new.s: Under Section 85(7) of APRA, the reservoirs under the River Management Boards are guarded by:
new.x: Sec. 85(7) provides for CISF to guard the reservoirs.

new.s: Under Section 85(1) of APRA, the two River Management Boards were to be set up within how many days of the appointed day?
new.x: Section 85(1) requires the two Boards within 60 days of the appointed day.
